sn47.3:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn47.3:1.3: “sādhu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti”.
sn47.3:1.4: evameva panidhekacce moghapurisā mameva ajjhesanti dhamme ca bhāsite mameva anubandhitabbaṃ maññantīti:
sn47.3:1.5: “desetu me bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ, desetu sugato saṅkhittena dhammaṃ, appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ, appevanāmāhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa dāyādo assanti.”
sn47.3:1.6: tasmātiha tvaṃ bhikkhu, ādimeva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu.
sn47.3:1.9: yato kho te bhikkhu, sīlaṃ suvisuddhaṃ bhavissati, diṭṭhi ca ujukā, tato tvaṃ bhikkhu, sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne tividhena bhāveyyāsi.
sn47.3:2.2: idha tvaṃ bhikkhu, ajjhattaṃ kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.3: bahiddhā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.4: ajjhattabahiddhā kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhā domanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.13: ajjhattabahiddhā dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.3:2.14: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ tividhena bhāvessasi, tato tuyhaṃ bhikkhu, yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti.
sn47.3:3.1: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn47.3:3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn47.3:3.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn47.3:3.4: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
